title: Bound the original n18 ABCD family by joint raw-price and compiler funding
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This scoped negative result rules out simultaneous necessary raw and tail funding for every nonnegative real signed-ABCD paid profile at exactly `.0033` and `.0033000005`, with the original [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) n18 caller and retained cutoff 17 / floor 18 / offset 1/5 / decay .97. The domain fixes rank mass 5915 and tag mass 3458 on ranks 1..6, with tag 6=2, p7=14, source helpers and every nonlocal coefficient unchanged. It includes signed reverse exchanges and arbitrary real pooling. No construction, new kappa, all-n or changed-route ceiling is claimed.

A rational Farkas separator covers the whole invariant plane. Raw feasibility requires local tail increase greater than 228.3675/228.3681, while an independent source-moment recount and explicit source-to-goal transport put available headroom below 140.0588/140.0589. All exact fractions and all six coefficient slacks are retained. Source $\gamma(C0)>.965$ is independently established; the author quote is not accepted as its proof.

A whole raw-profitable witness failing gamma would leave partial mixtures open; the invariant-plane dual closes that gap in this precise retained scope.

The newer [PR5565](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5565) commuting-contact cascade at exact head `9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95` claims conditional kappa `.00308520`, tested `.0030852005`, with 66,726 paid jobs and 12,814 productive fields. Its Stage A commutes four ADDs into the zero-dimensional chart; Stage B changes the scalar chronology and helper 531 from H8 to H9. Those changes leave this original [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) fixed-helper invariant domain, so the obstruction does not transfer automatically. See its pinned [claim](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/CLAIM.md), [proof](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/PROOF.md) and [result](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/RESULT.json). The authenticated 21:24:19 UTC curator checkpoint records its hosted run 40234415339 as in progress. This is an author conditional claim, not selected or independently admitted. The frozen exact-source obstruction remains scoped to the original [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) bill and retained compiler parameters.

Frame optimization in 5575 and input/output basis work in 5125 remain separate constructive work; this package performs no physical contact or basis search. The retained 20:48:16 UTC snapshot is historical and is not presented as a latest family inventory or exhaustive novelty search.
